697fb953-ecb3-4a54-832b-7055d4559df1.quote: We opened with first blood, Terra onto Crunch at 1.7 minutes, and two lanes ran clean the whole game: Steel shut out Sevarog and Kira never lost to Drongo. Aurora held an early jungle edge over Khaimera before that lane evened out. The exception was mid, where Neon lost to Gideon from start to finish. Gideon finished with the match's biggest damage total, 68k magical, and only one of our heroes itemized magic resist against him. That mid deficit showed up on the map: river buffs went 2-26 their way and towers finished 2-10. The fights told the same story. We won six fights outright and turned none of them into a tower or objective, while they cashed five of their seven wins. The two most expensive losses, at 10.4 near their Fangtooth and at 16.3 at their Inner Tower, both had an alive teammate who wasn't losing their lane sitting out while the rest fought and lost by three or more bodies. The fights at 18.8 and 26.8 were then started with our midlaner still pinned in his losing lane — the wrong calls with a fifth already stuck across the map. The game ended at 29.6 minutes with the full roster in a straight fight at their Core, lost 0-5. Next game: when a teammate is alive and holding their lane, get them into the fight before it starts. Both of the costliest losses had exactly that gap open.

96bd0088-5c40-4263-863f-732fc8d5513d.quote: Our pre-game read called four of five lanes theirs. The map disagreed, because we only fought where our objectives were. The leak first: three solo deaths between 8.7 and 15, Shinbi to Khaimera, Phase to Kira, and Renna to Khaimera. That was the one pattern that survived the win. Everything else was a conversion clinic. The fight at our Mini Prime at 12.7 was won 2-0. The fight at our Fangtooth at 17.1 was won 3-0 with two of ours against three. The fight at our inhibitor at 24.6 was won 3-1, and the fight at 26.7 was won 2-1. Every single win was cashed inside the window. Their only won fight, at our inner tower at 18.8 and taken while Greystone and Renna stayed in lane, cashed into nothing. The major board read Fangtooth at 10, 17 and 24, Mini Prime at 14, Genesis Core at 20 and Orb Prime at 22, all ours, with only the seedlings at 4 and 11 going theirs. Zero majors were conceded, and not one of our deaths preceded a lost structure. One draft note to carry forward: our damage was four-fifths magical, so a single enemy magic-resist item blunts most of it, and a tougher lobby will buy one. Next game: same rule that won this one — fight at our objectives, cash every win before the timers end.

c357e754-d09a-4cf9-a902-fedcbf471f95.quote: Our pre-game read called carry and offlane theirs, but the neutral map was conceded before any of that mattered: the 6-minute Fangtooth fell uncontested with all five of us alive. The pattern set early. Steel and TwinBlast won the river skirmish at 4.4, 3-0, and the other side simply traded it for Fangtooth across the map. We kept winning moments and taking nothing: Eden's solo 2-0 at 11.2, then the fight at their Mini Prime at 18, won 2-1, with Fangtooth again falling cross-map. The collapse ran from 19.1 to 21.2. The fight at their inner tower at 19.1 was lost 1-3 with The Fey alive and ahead. The fight at their Fangtooth at 20.5 was lost 0-3 with Scarlett alive and ahead. Fangtooth, the inner and outer towers, and our first inhibitor all fell between 20.1 and 21.2. To our credit, we caught them out five times and gave back only one solo death, TwinBlast to Khaimera at 21.4. But the major board by the end was brutal. They took Fangtooth at 6, 14 and 20, Primal Fangtooth at 27 and 33, and Orb Prime at 27 and 34, with both Orb Primes uncontested while five of us were alive. Our single major all game was the 30-minute Genesis Core. We even won the last fight at their inhibitor at 37.7, 4-2. Across the map, The Fey and Eden died, and our inhibitor fell at 37.9 with the Core following at 38.3. Next game: the second a fight is won, all five walk to the nearest objective. Seven wins with one cashed is a habit worth breaking.
